messages:
irene-support: Hey team — NimbleHealth reported they lost access to the tenant console and cannot create model keys after yesterday's RBAC attribute refactor. Billing page shows 403. Pls advise; customer is blocked.
ajay-sre: Investigating. Can you paste the user's `x-org-id` and an example request ID?
irene-support: org=nimblehealth-prod, user alice@nimblehealth.com, req=01G7X4ZQ5Y2A3B6C0KQR0TZ1
ajay-sre: I see `KMS:Decrypt` failing in the audit logs for tenant-scoped key: `error=AccessDenied; reason=key policy denies usage for principal arn:aws:iam::...:role/tenants-service`
sam-security: That matches the attribute sync job that ran at 2026-03-18T03:14:22Z — we flattened `tenant_role` -> `role_level` and a couple of principals lost the `tenant:` attribute. Probable cause: role mapping filter didn't include service principals.
maria-devex: Customer impact: console and model operations which unwrap per-tenant wrapped keys will 403. We need a quick remediation (customer-facing) and a durable fix.
ajay-sre: Quick mitigation: re-run attribute rollforward to re-add `tenant:nimblehealth-prod` to the service principal and rewrap the key grant. I'm going to run the dry-run first.
ajay-sre: ```
# dry-run
./tools/attr-sync --env prod --org nimblehealth-prod --preview
# shows missing attributes on arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tenants-service
```
irene-support: Customer requested ETA. Can we get this done within 30m?
ajay-sre: If dry-run looks good I'll execute. Calling it out to @sam-security for approval to touch key grants.
sam-security: Approve for emergency remediation. Post the exact commands here; we'll need KMS audit entries and a short blameless note.
ajay-sre: Executing remediation now. Steps: 1) add attribute, 2) create new grant on customer key with `Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey`, 3) invalidate cached key wraps.
ajay-sre: ```
./tools/attr-sync --env prod --org nimblehealth-prod --apply
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/redwood-tenant-nimblehealth --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/tenants-service --operations Encrypt Decrypt GenerateDataKey
# then purge cache: curl -X POST https://internal-cache.redwood/v1/purge?org=nimblehealth-prod
```
kms-bot: [audit] grant-created key=alias/redwood-tenant-nimblehealth grantId=3f2a9c created_by=ajay-sre at=2026-03-18T04:08:03Z
ajay-sre: Confirming keys unwrap now for alice. Ran same request id: 01G7X4ZQ5Y2A3B6C0KQR0TZ1 — decrypt succeeded.
irmy: (typo — ignore)
irene-support: Customer confirms console access restored and billing page loads. They still saw a stale 403 on one route; cleared after cache purge.
sam-security: We'll open a follow-up PR to the attribute-sync filter to include `serviceAccount` principals and add unit tests. Also add a migration job to scan for tenants with missing attributes and auto-fix within a safe window.
maria-devex: I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem and a short how-to for SEs to run the emergency remediation steps. Keep it short and prescriptive.
ajay-sre: Action items: (1) PR attribute-sync filter (sam) (2) migration job + runbook (ajay + maria) (3) KMS audit retention check to ensure grant logs are preserved for 180 days (sam). I'll tag owners in the ticket.
irene-support: Thanks all — closing loop with NimbleHealth; they want a summary and the logs. I'll attach the KMS audit lines and the dry-run output in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
